name: Fukuina Kousei
source:
The president of the company where Norikazu and Emika work after moving to the city.
He arranges housing for them and helps Emika, who came along with them, find a job.
He has a laid-back attitude toward sex and even hosts adult video viewing parties with his employees.
Apparently, he runs several businesses across various industries.
